pages.text: Log, first descent. Outside every universe there is a single, endless space. A $(thing)World Tree$() of an unknown material towers over it, more than four hundred blocks high.

Its branches spread for more than a thousand blocks in every direction, and every branch carries $(item)Bubble Universes$() - entire cosmoses, each the size of a fist. Break one to take a sample.$(br2)Eternal inflation predicts exactly this: pocket universes budding off a larger space. I never expected to pick one.

$(item)Arbor Heartwood$() does not behave normally. It drifts between four phases:$(li)dormant$(li)$(thing)inverted$() - gravity reverses for whatever stands on it$(li)$(thing)luminous$() - blazing light, and it hurries you along$(li)$(thing)unreal$() - no light at all, and things fall as if through syrup

Below the Tree lies the $(thing)Ocean of Primordial Law$(). Laws bubble up out of it and pop out of existence again; anything that swims in it obeys whichever law is in force at that moment. Strangely, it is breathable. I checked twice.
Note to self: it can be distilled. The Ocean yields $(item)Axiom Fragments$() and $(item)Crystallised Law$().
An entire universe hanging from a branch of the World Tree, caught before it fell.$(br2)Made in $(item)Universe Forge$().
A shard of a foundational rule. Mathematics is built on these; so is reality.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().
A law of nature that bubbled up from the Primordial Ocean and froze before it could pop.$(br2)Made in $(item)Axiom Distiller$().

$(thing)Where these go$():$(li)$(item)Arbor Heartwood$(): Arbor Heartwood Sample, Arbor Simulacrum, Hyperreal Cache, Omnilex Casing, Omnilex Engine$(li)$(item)Bubble Universe$(): Arbor Simulacrum, Cosmic Flux Coupler, Omnilex Seal, Panspermia Seed, Transfinite Lattice Bolt$(li)$(item)Axiom Fragment$(): Absolute Notes I, Axiom Key, Axiomatic Field Emitter, Crystallised Law, Paradox Residue and more$(li)$(item)Crystall...

$(thing)Dimension data: Hyperdimensional Reality$()$(br2)$(thing)Nature$(): Gravity 1 g, 11 spatial dimensions, time x1, ordinary vacuum.$(br2)$(thing)Carry$(): $(item)Primordial Charter$() - with it, a new law every minute and a half.
